The reclaim design is sound and the cited code exists as described (read): disk_gate at run/mod.rs:749 and 1301, the producer entered at run/producer.rs:153, Athena::running (status.rs:1609), try_lock_job, remove_target, write_resume, with_free_space, Registry::register and reap, sweep_idle_targets, and d.st().tried. It removes only target/, and only for jobs that are Dispatched in Records, have no registry entry, have a free job lock held during removal and are not one of the drain's own jobs. So the drain tests for criteria 1, 2 and 3(b) do not build as planned. Criterion 2's test passes on today's code, because the dispatch gate already holds the job. The plan says so honestly and routes the producer.rs scope question to the user. That is acceptable but minor: the question should go to the user before the producer runs.
